To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) FLICA is a novel framework for leadership identification and model classification that is easily applied to coordinated activity data, (b) FLICA can accurately identify the identities of leaders and classify the type of coordination model, and (c) the framework is generalizable to any dataset with a similar structure.

(1) We propose a framework to infer leaders in coordinated activity based on the behavior of individuals in a group; (2) We propose a set of five features that can be extracted from the behavior of individuals to identify leadership model; (3) We demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework on both simulated data and real-world data.

(1) we propose FLICA, a framework for leader identification in coordinated activity, (2), FLICA is able to identify periods of coordinated activity, (3) FLICA is able classify the likely mechanism by with the group coordination occurred, (4) FLICA is easily generalizable, and (5) FLICA performs well on both simulated and non-simulated data.
